name: @ascend/ascendawesome
description: AscendAwesome design system — Ascend theme and curated components built on Web Awesome
_comment: Publish registry comes from .npmrc — Azure Artifacts does not support publishConfig.registry overrides at publish time.

scripts.build:css: mkdir -p dist/themes && postcss src/themes/ascend.css -o dist/themes/ascend.css && postcss src/themes/ascend.css -o dist/themes/ascend.min.css --env production
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:components && npm run build:css && npm run build:cdn
